items.title: File Einspruch (objection) against the tax assessment
items.quote: Legen Sie ihn innerhalb eines Monats ab Bekanntgabe beim Finanzamt Musterwolgast ein, schriftlich, elektronisch oder zur Niederschrift.
items.computation: Bescheid dated Friday 20.11.2026, sent by post. Letter states the deemed delivery (Bekanntgabe) day is the 4th day after posting (current §122 Abs.2 AO rule): 20.11.2026 + 4 days = 24.11.2026 (Tuesday, not a weekend/holiday, so it stands as the Bekanntgabe day). The one-month objection period begins the day after Bekanntgabe (§108 Abs.1 AO, §187 Abs.1 BGB), i.e. 25.11.2026, and ends on the day of the following month that numerically corresponds to the Bekanntgabe day (§188 Abs.2 BGB): 24.12.2026. 24.12.2026 is a Thursday and not a statutory public holiday in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern (only 25./26.12 are holidays), so no further shift applies (§108 Abs.3 AO, §193 BGB).
